theater: 揚州江都城與聊城大陸縣

battle.name: 宇文化及江都之亂
battle.theater: 揚州江都城與聊城大陸縣
battle.brief: 大業十四年（618）三月，隋煬帝楊廣在江都宮中被虎賁郎將司馬德戡、裴虔通等與宇文化及策動的政變縊殺。宇文化及立秦王楊浩、自稱丞相，率驍果軍十餘萬北上攻李密、竇建德，翌年三月在聊城被竇建德俘斬。卡面羅馬標槍為古典義大利步兵重投槍，與本役相隔七百年。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 這場亂事表面上是隋朝內部的一次宮廷變亂，實則是禁軍、割據勢力與流亡朝廷三方在隋末崩潰中的正面碰撞。交戰的一方是隋朝中央與它的行在朝廷：大業末年府兵制已形同虛設，兵源改由各地募充與京畿宿衛把持，十二衛與殿內、驍果、虎賁諸軍並存，兵將之間的指揮關係多出於私人恩義；江都是煬帝自大業十二年巡幸後的宮禁所在，煬帝把天下兵甲、宮人與儀仗都集中在運河盡頭的這座城裡，宮城宿衛與朝中侍從因此既握槍桿又貼近君側，成為政變中可以直接下手的環節。另一方是江都禁軍內部一批中下級軍官與他們裹挾的驍果軍：骨幹是虎賲郎將司馬德戡、裴虔通，直閣元禮、虎牙郎將趙行樞、勳侍楊士覽與直長薛世良，由趙行樞等勸說宇文化及出面主事，並以司宮魏氏為內應；事成之後，宇文化及以丞相、總百揆之名接管十二衛、內史省與尚書省，把兄長宇文智及置於左僕射兼十二衛大將軍、弟宇文士及置於內史令，組成一整套以門下舊交與姻親為核心的班底。第三方則是逐漸成形的三家割據軍：奉洛陽越王楊侗詔書討伐宇文化及的瓦崗軍李密與守黎陽倉的徐世勣、主動請討弒君者的夏國竇建德，以及在洛陽與李密相爭的王世充。隋朝中央在江都崩解之後，法統一分為二：江都的楊浩與洛陽的楊侗，兩個傀儡各自發號施令，任何一方想取得天下，都得先解決另外一方。
countriesEn: On the surface this disturbance was a palace coup inside the Sui; in reality it was a three-way collision between the palace guard, the regional rebel armies and a fugitive court in the collapsing empire of 618. One side was the Sui centre and its travelling court: by the end of the Dayuan era the fubing militia system inherited from the Northern Zhou had become a formality, troops came by local recruitment and were in the hands of the capital guard, the Twelve Guards and the palace, xiaoguo and huben corps all existed side by side, and the chain of command between officers and men rested far more on private obligation than on any written regulation. Jiangdu was the palace city where Yang Guang had held court since his tour of 616, and the emperor had concentrated the weapons, palace women and ceremonial apparatus of the empire in this town at the end of the canal; the palace guard and the court attendants therefore held both the weapons and constant access to the sovereign's person, and they were precisely the link a coup could seize. The other side was a group of junior and middling officers of the Jiangdu guard together with the xiaoguo soldiers they carried with them: the backbone was the huben langjiang Sima Dekan, Pei Qiantong, the zhibu Yuan Li, the huyalangjiang Zhao Xingshu, the xunshi Yang Shilan and the zhichang Xue Shiliang, with Zhao Xingshu and the others persuading Yu Wenhuaji to take the lead and the palace eunuch Wei Shi serving as their agent inside the palace. Once the coup had succeeded, Yu Wenhuaji, styling himself chancellor and holder of all the powers of state, took over the Twelve Guards, the Department of State Affairs and the Department of the Palace, put his elder brother Yuwen Zhiji in charge as Left Pushe and commander of the Twelve Guards, and his younger brother Yuwen Shiji as Neishi Ling, building an entire establishment out of former associates and in-laws. The third party was the three regional powers now taking shape: the Wagang army of Li Mi and Xu Shiji at the Liyang depot, acting on an edict of Yang Tong, Prince of Yue, in Luoyang; the Xia state of Dou Jiande, who came of his own accord to punish the regicide; and Wang Shichong at Luoyang, who was fighting Li Mi for that city. Once the Sui centre had collapsed at Jiangdu the lawful line split in two, the puppet Yang Hao at Jiangdu and the puppet Yang Tong at Luoyang, and each side had to dispose of the other before it could claim the empire.
people: 直接決定這場亂局走向的是被殺的隋煬帝楊廣。他把朝廷搬上運河，第三次巡幸江都，把宮城、龍舟與迷樓的營造留給這座南方城市，自己卻不再回頭看關中的局勢；大業十四年（618）三月，他身邊的宿衛與侍從已多懷去意，他仍在玄武門與顯福宮之間往返，直到那場政變把他從床上拖到殿中。宇文化及是先帝遺澤與本朝寵信堆出來的人：其父宇文述是隋朝左翊衛大將軍、許國公，他以門蔭起家千牛備身，長期出入太子楊廣左右，父死之後更被起用為右屯衛將軍、襲許國公爵；但他性格怯懦貪劣，遇事既無擔當亦無謀略，被趙行樞、薛世良推上主位時嚇得變色流汗，事後卻用最殘酷的手段鞏固權位。真正執行弒君的是幾名中下級軍官：虎賁郎將司馬德戡主持其事，裴虔通持刀劫持煬帝並殺死趙王楊杲，校尉令狐行達奉命以煬帝解下的白巾將他縊死，司宮魏氏則以內應身份在玄武門支開了數百給使，使煬帝死時無人可救。江都方面被清洗的朝臣包括內史侍郎虞世基、左翊衛大將軍來護兒、御史大夫裴蘊、著作郎許善心與書監袁充，虞世南抱住兄長屍體號泣，許善心之母范氏絕食十餘日而死；蘇威因早已失寵而免死。反方向上，竇建德自稱隋朝子民、該討弒君者，李密奉楊侗之詔討宇文化及並因此取得魏國公的正式封號，李神通奉唐命追討宇文化及，最後的結局則由竇建德的將士與王薄的內應共同決定。
peopleEn: The man whose fate decided the course of this affair was the slain Sui Yangdi, Yang Guang. He had moved the court onto the canal; on his third tour of Jiangdu he left the building of the palace city, of the dragon boat and of the Maze Tower to this southern town, while he himself no longer looked back at the situation in Guanzhong. By the third month of Dayuan fourteen (618) the guards and attendants around him were already for the most part thinking of escape, yet he kept moving between the Xuanwu Gate and the Xianfu Palace until the coup dragged him from his bed into the hall. Yu Wenhuaji was a man built out of his father's legacy and the reigning court's favour: his father Yuwen Shu was the Sui's Left Yiwei Grand General and Duke of Xu, and he entered office by privilege as a Qianniu bodyguard, attending the heir Yang Guang for years; after his father's death he was raised to Right Tunwei General and allowed to inherit the ducal title of Xu. Yet he was cowardly and greedy, equal to nothing in resolution or cunning, and when Zhao Xingshu and Xue Shiliang pushed him into the lead he turned white and sweated with fear; once the coup had succeeded, however, he consolidated his power by the cruellest means. The actual regicide was carried out by middling officers: the huben langjiang Sima Dekan directed the business, Pei Qiantong took the emperor by force with a blade and killed the Prince of Zhao, Yang Gao, the commandant Linghu Xingda was ordered to strangle him with the white silk sash the emperor had taken off, and the palace eunuch Wei Shi, acting as the party's agent inside, sent several hundred service men out of the Xuanwu Gate so that no one could come to the emperor's aid. Those at court in Jiangdu who were purged included the Neishi Shilang Yu Shiji, the Left Yiwei Grand General Lai Hu, the Censor-in-Chief Pei Yun, the Compiler-in-Chief Xu Shixin and the Director of the Secretariat Yuan Chong; Yu Shinan threw himself on his brother's body and wailed, and the mother of Xu Shixin, aged ninety-two, starved herself to death after more than ten days. Su Wei was spared because he had already lost the emperor's favour. On the other side, Dou Jiande proclaimed himself a subject of the Sui who ought to punish the regicide; Li Mi received the edict of Yang Tong to campaign against Yu Wenhuaji and thereby won the formal title of Duke of Wei; Li Shentong pursued Yu Wenhuaji on the orders of the Tang; and the end of the affair was settled by the soldiers of Dou Jiande together with the treachery of Wang Bo.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬標槍是古典義大利共和國末期至帝國初期的步兵重投槍，槍榫以青銅或鐵製成，細長而沉重，接在輕木桿前端，捅入盾面之後會當場折斷，使敵人無法把盾抬起重複使用。必須說明的是，羅馬標槍與隋末江都之亂相隔七百餘年，既沒有隨商旅或使節進入中土，也不可能出現在任何一支隋軍的編裝之中；它在這場戰役裡只能作為同類兵器在功能上的一個對照。真正在江都城頭、運河船隊與河北平原上相向的，是中原自己的兵器。隋軍的近身冷兵器以橫刀、儀刀與槊為主，馬上用長柄馬槊，步陣用長矛與大盾，格鬥的基本動作是刺、劈、斬；遠程火力則是弓與弩，隋制有擘張弩、角弓弩與機弩，箭鏃有普通的鐵鏃，也有用來射穿札甲的破甲箭。攻城一方能調動的器械包括撞車、機石、雲梯、巢車與飛石車，守城一方則以拒馬、鹿角、鐵鵰、水門與井欄構成障礙；竇建德攻聊城時明確使用的就是撞車與機石，四面急攻。防護上，隋軍與夏軍以明光鎧、札甲與盾為主，鎧甲的價值使穿盾的打法在歐洲備受重視，而漢軍同樣面對以盾結陣的敵人，靠的則是步槊與弩的配合。江都還有一支別處沒有的裝備：運河船隊。煬帝在江都造有大艦與御用龍舟，政變之後宇文化及奪取江都人的舟楫，準備循水路西歸彭城，並強徵百姓車牛二千輛搬運宮人珍寶，兵甲則由軍士肩負；北伐李密時又渡永濟渠，依靠漕船輸送。兵器之外，真正的戰略物資是糧食：江都一帶物產繁富，可一旦運河被斷、江南的米粟運不進來，軍隊便在數月之內耗盡存糧。
kitsEn: The Roman pilum on the card is the heavy throwing javelin of the infantry of the late Roman Republic and early Empire: a slender but heavy bronze or iron shank fitted to the front of a light wooden shaft, which broke off as soon as it had been driven into a shield and so left the defender unable to lift the shield and use it again. It has to be said plainly that the pilum stands more than seven hundred years away from the disturbances at the end of the Sui; it reached China neither through trade nor through envoys, and it cannot have formed part of the equipment of any Sui army. Within this campaign it can only serve as a comparison of function between like weapons. What actually met each other on the walls of Jiangdu, in the canal fleets and on the plains of Hebei were the weapons of China proper. The close combat arms of the Sui were the hengdao sabre, the yidao and the shao: long-handled horse spears for the cavalry, long spears and large shields for the foot, with stabbing, chopping and cutting as the basic actions of fighting. The ranged strength was the bow and the crossbow; the Sui regulations list the crossbow drawn by a strongman, the horn bow and the mounted crossbow, and the arrowheads include ordinary iron heads as well as armour-piercing heads meant to shoot through lamellar armour. The besiegers could bring up battering rams, stone-throwers, scaling ladders, siege towers and traction trebuchets; the defenders built obstacles out of caltrops, deer-horn barriers, iron crows, water gates and well-heads. When Dou Jiande stormed Liaocheng he used exactly battering rams and stone-throwers, attacking from all four sides. For protection, Sui and Xia troops relied on bright armour, lamellar armour and shields, and the value of armour is what made shield-piercing throws so prized in Europe; the Chinese armies met shield-formed formations in the same way, and met them with foot spears and crossbows working together. Jiangdu also had a kind of equipment found nowhere else: the canal fleet. Yang Guang had ships and his imperial dragon boat built at Jiangdu, and after the coup Yu Wenhuaji took the boats of the townspeople, preparing to travel back west to Pengcheng by water, while impressing two thousand carts and oxen from the people to carry palace women and treasure; armour and weapons had to be carried on the soldiers' own backs, and when he campaigned against Li Mi he crossed the Yongji canal and relied on the grain boats for his transport. Beyond weapons, the true strategic material was food. The region around Jiangdu was rich, but if the canal was cut and the rice of the south could no longer be brought up, an army would exhaust its stores within a few months.
tactics: 這場戰爭的開局是一場標準的宮廷政變，而不是兩軍在野外交鋒。發難者都在禁軍與宿衛之中，熟悉玄武門、顯福宮與宮城的門禁與值守時段；他們用司宮魏氏的假詔把安排在玄武門的數百給使調出，使煬帝遇害時無法得到近侍的救援，然後由虎賲郎將司馬德戡引兵直入宮城，裴虔通持刀劫持，校尉令狐行達執行縊殺，鷹揚郎將孟秉以甲騎接應，天明後宇文化及以丞相之號入朝堂。奪權之後，戰術重點轉為控制與轉運：宇文化及以儀仗等同帝王乘輿的排場出巡，留左武衛將軍陳稜守江都，奪取江都人的舟楫、徵用百姓車牛二千輛，準備循運河北上，兵甲則由軍士肩負，隊伍一旦離開水路由，士卒的怨望便隨里程累積。北上之後，他的用兵只剩下急於求活的一種辦法：七月與李密在童山交戰，他本欲乘李密糧盡偷襲，卻因部下逃奔告密而反被對方知悉，遂渡永濟渠先發制人，在童山擊中李密，卻被帳內驃騎秦叔寶救下；兵敗之後他避實擊虛，轉入汲郡向東郡吏民拷掠米粟，又收羅陳智略、樊文超、張童兒等部的叛降者補充兵力，最後率餘部二萬退守魏縣。防守上他只能依賴深溝高壘與攻城器械，而徐世勣在黎陽倉外掘深溝、從護城河中挖地道反擊，焚燒其攻城器械；李密則用深溝高壢、不與交鋒、每逢敵攻便引兵襲其後方的辦法拖住他。最後的攻城發生在聊城：竇建德以撞車與機石四面急攻，鄭善果督戰中流矢，王薄開門放入夏軍，宇文化及才被生擒。
tacticsEn: The opening of this war was a textbook palace coup rather than a pitched battle in the field. All the conspirators belonged to the palace guard and the garrison troops, and knew the gates of the Xuanwu Gate, the Xianfu Palace and the palace city, and the hours at which they were watched. They used a false edict from the palace eunuch Wei Shi to send several hundred service men out of the Xuanwu Gate, so that when Yang Guang was attacked no attendant could come to his aid; then the huben langjiang Sima Dekan led armed men straight into the palace city, Pei Qiantong seized the emperor with a blade, the commandant Linghu Xingda carried out the strangling, and the yingyang langjiang Meng Bing met the conspirators with armoured cavalry outside; by daylight Yu Wenhuaji had entered the hall of state under the title of chancellor. After the seizure of power the tactical emphasis shifted to control and transport. Yu Wenhuaji travelled with a ceremonial apparatus equal to an emperor's carriage, left the Left Wuwei General Chen Leng to hold Jiangdu, seized the boats of the townspeople and impressed two thousand carts and oxen, preparing to move north along the canal; the armour and weapons went on the soldiers' backs, and once the column left the water road the men's resentment grew with every mile of the march. After moving north, only one method remained to him, born of urgency to find food. In the seventh month he fought Li Mi at Tongshan: he had meant to catch Li Mi with an attack while the latter's supplies ran out, but a fugitive from his own ranks carried the plan to the enemy, so he crossed the Yongji canal and struck first, wounding Li Mi at Tongshan, who was saved by the qipai cavalry commander Qin Shubao in the tent. After the defeat he avoided the enemy's strength and struck at its weakness, turned into Jixun and squeezed grain and millet from the officials and people of Dongjun, and took in deserters from the units of Chen Zhilue, Fan Wenchao and Zhang Tong'er to make up his numbers, before finally retiring north with twenty thousand men to Wei county. In defence he could rely on nothing but deep trenches and high banks and his siege engines, while Xu Shiji outside the Liyang depot dug a deep trench and drove a tunnel from out of his own moat, and burned his siege engines. Li Mi's method was to hold deep entrenchments, refuse to give battle, and turn on the enemy's rear every time he attacked. The last siege was fought at Liaocheng: Dou Jiande pressed the attack from all four sides with battering rams and stone-throwers, Zheng Shanguo was wounded by a stray arrow while directing the defence, and Wang Bo opened the gate to the Xia army; only then was Yu Wenhuaji taken alive.
data: 可以確定的數字大致如下。政變發生在大業十四年（618）三月，宇文化及於四月入據六宮時擁兵十餘萬；九月他毒殺傀儡皇帝楊浩、自立為許王，年號天壽，置百官，封宇文智及為齊王、宇文士及為蜀王，時距江都兵變不足半年。隋煬帝生於569年，遇害時四十九歲。兵變骨幹人數不多，司馬德戡、裴虔通、元禮、趙行樞、楊士覽、薛世良、魏氏，加上被裹挾的驍果軍，但驍果軍多為關中出身，思鄉欲歸，這既是宇文化及敢於發動政變的底氣，也是他無法長期控制的根源。八月他在汲郡一帶逼迫東郡吏民交出米粟，同時陳智略率嶺南驍果萬餘人、樊文超率江淮軍、張童兒率江東驍果數千人叛投李密；他率餘部二萬北走魏縣，以吏部尚書楊恭仁守城，李神通破魏縣時斬獲二千餘人。武德二年（619）正月他攻魏州總管元寶藏，四十日不能下，反為所敗，楊恭仁被俘送唐；閏二月李神通圍聊城十餘日不能攻克，竇建德兵到、李神通退兵，夏軍以撞車與機石攻破聊城，宇文化及與其子宇文承基、宇文承趾被擒，押往夏國都城襄國郡，於大陸縣被斬，首級與蕭皇后、楊政道一併送給與突厥和親的義成公主。三月二十一日他伏誅。附帶一提，煬帝在江都所造的龍舟與大艦、宇文化及徵用的百姓車牛二千輛，以及江都與洛陽之間二千餘里的運河航程，都說明這一場亂事始終是一個糧與船的問題。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The coup took place in the third month of Dayuan fourteen (618), and in the fourth month Yu Wenhuaji, entering and occupying the six palaces, had more than a hundred thousand men under him. In the ninth month he poisoned the puppet emperor Yang Hao, proclaimed himself King of Xu with the era name Tianshou, set up the hundred officials and ennobled Yuwen Zhiji as Prince of Qi and Yuwen Shiji as Prince of Shu, less than half a year after the mutiny in Jiangdu. Yang Guang was born in 569 and was forty-nine when he was killed. The number of men at the head of the mutiny was small: Sima Dekan, Pei Qiantong, Yuan Li, Zhao Xingshu, Yang Shilan, Xue Shiliang and Wei Shi, together with the xiaoguo soldiers they carried with them; but the xiaoguo were largely men from Guanzhong who longed to go home, and that was at once the confidence behind Yu Wenhuaji's daring and the reason he could not hold them for long. In the eighth month he pressed the officials and people of Dongjun for grain and millet around Jixun, while at the same time Chen Zhilue led more than ten thousand xiaoguo of Lingnan, Fan Wenchao the troops of the Jiang and Huai, and Zhang Tong'er several thousand xiaoguo of Jiangdong over to Li Mi. He marched north with the remaining twenty thousand men to Wei county, leaving the Minister of Personnel Yang Gongren to hold the town, and when Li Shentong broke Wei county he took more than two thousand heads. In the first month of Wude two (619) he attacked the Wei zhou zongguan Yuan Baozang and could not take the place in forty days, and was beaten instead, Yang Gongren being captured and sent to the Tang. In the intercalary second month Li Shentong besieged Liaocheng for more than ten days without success; when Dou Jiande's troops arrived Li Shentong withdrew, the Xia army broke Liaocheng with battering rams and stone-throwers, and Yu Wenhuaji and his sons Yuwen Chengji and Yuwen Chengzhi were taken. They were sent under guard to the Xia capital of Xianguo prefecture and beheaded in the mainland county, and the head was handed with the Empress Dowager Xiao and Yang Zhengdao to the Princess Yicheng, who had married into the Turks. On the twenty-first day of the third month he was put to death. By way of supporting detail, the dragon boat and great ships built by Yang Guang at Jiangdu, the two thousand carts and oxen impressed by Yu Wenhuaji, and the two thousand-odd li of canal navigation between Jiangdu and Luoyang all show that this affair was, from beginning to end, a question of grain and of boats.
cause: 把話說到底，這場亂事是隋朝在崩潰邊緣的一次內部爆裂。煬帝自大業十二年（616）起三次巡幸江都，把行在與中央機構搬到運河的盡頭，卻拒絕北還，也拒絕讓關中的消息擾亂江都；他調天下精兵與甲仗集中到江都，而兵部的將領仍在長安與洛陽，北周的府兵制早已崩壞，募來的驍果軍雖精壯卻多不願客死南方，逃亡之念與日俱增。財政與轉輸的崩潰先到：三次征高句麗耗空了國庫與民力，江南的米粟要靠新挖的運河一船一船運到江都與洛陽，一旦運河或沿途的治安出了問題，宮廷、軍隊與官僚的食糧便同時失去著落。人事上，煬帝的父執宇文述病重時曾為長子宇文化及求情，煬帝念舊起用他為右屯衛將軍並讓他襲封許國公，等於在王朝最脆弱的時候把權柄交給一個素無軍功、又毫無威望的外戚近臣；宇文化及本人貪墨成性、屢被罷免，父子倆在公卿間的失禮，早就把江都的禁軍與朝臣推向相反的方向。外部壓力則同時來自三個方向：河北與中原的竇建德、李密以勤王與討逆為名進軍，江南的杜伏威、沈法興各自割據，東突厥的曷娑那可汗在煬帝死後一度追隨宇文化及。洛陽朝廷更做了一個關鍵決定：赦免李密、授他封號，讓他與宇文化及互相消耗。於是，表面的宮廷殺局很快變成一場把隋朝最後一點元氣燒乾的內戰。
causeEn: At bottom, this disturbance was an internal rupture of the Sui on the edge of collapse. From 616 Yang Guang made three tours of Jiangdu and moved the travelling court and the central institutions to the end of the canal, yet refused to go north and refused to let news from Guanzhong disturb Jiangdu. He concentrated the picked troops and armour of the empire at Jiangdu, while the generals of the Ministry of War remained at Chang'an and Luoyang; the fubing system of the Northern Zhou had long since decayed, and the recruited xiaoguo, though tough, were mostly unwilling to die far from home, so the urge to desert grew day by day. Financial and transport collapse came first of all: the three campaigns against Goguryeo had drained the treasury and the people, and the rice of the south had to be brought up to Jiangdu and Luoyang in boatloads along a newly dug canal; if the canal or the security of the road along it failed, the food of court, army and bureaucracy would fail together. In personnel matters, Yang Guang's adviser Yuwen Shu had pleaded for his eldest son as he lay dying, and the emperor, mindful of the old friendship, raised Yu Wenhuaji to Right Tunwei General and allowed him to inherit the title of Duke of Xu, handing the reins of power at the most fragile moment of the dynasty to a kinsman from the maternal side who had no record of command and no standing of his own. Yu Wenhuaji himself was greedy and was repeatedly dismissed from office, and the two of them were insolent in the presence of the ministers; the guard and the court of Jiangdu had long been pushed in opposite directions by such conduct. External pressure came from three sides at once: Dou Jiande and Li Mi in Hebei and the central plain advanced under the banners of serving the dynasty and punishing the rebels; Du Fuwei and Shen Faxing carved out separate powers in the south; and the Eastern Turkic khan Gesangna followed Yu Wenhuaji for a time after Yang Guang's death. The Luoyang court then made a decisive choice: it pardoned Li Mi, gave him titles, and set the two men to wear each other down. The palace killing thus quickly turned into a civil war that burned out the last of the Sui's strength.
impact: 江都兵變的第一個後果，是隋朝在形式與實質上同時崩解。煬帝死後，江都立秦王楊浩、洛陽立越王楊侗，兩個傀儡朝廷各據半壁；宇文化及自立許王，李密奉楊侗之詔討逆而受封魏國公、拜太尉與尚書令，瓦崗軍由此獲得法統上的正當性，兵威與地盤一併膨脹；但同一場戰爭也讓王世充得以在洛陽反手壓倒李密，河北的竇建德以為隋朝子民、當討弒君者的名義誅死宇文化及、為煬帝發喪、取得蕭皇后的名分，一時山東多歸附，夏國的聲勢反而在隋末群雄中最為強盛。戰爭的第三重後果落在制度與人心上：唐太宗貞觀二年（628）以裴虔通等人弒君為不可取，削爵流放；同年又追究牛方裕、薛世良、唐奉義、高元禮等同黨，一律流放嶺南；貞觀七年（633）再下詔令宇文化及一黨的子孫不予錄用。弒君不為功臣所容、從此連累子孫，被寫成不可翻案的成例；後來武則天朝其子宇文承基想援引父親的勳舊請授蔭官，也被當面駁回。地方層面上，江都失去行在的頭銜，揚州從帝國的政治心臟降為一州之地，先後為沈法興與杜伏威部將輔公祏所占，江南進入被重新整合的過程；運河、鹽利與江南的米粟，則在此後唐一代重新綁在中央的調度之下，隋末江南的割據局面由此慢慢收束。
impactEn: The first consequence of the mutiny at Jiangdu was that the Sui dissolved in form and in substance at the same time. After Yang Guang's death the court at Jiangdu set up the Prince of Qin, Yang Hao, while Luoyang set up the Prince of Yue, Yang Tong; two puppet courts each held half the empire. Yu Wenhuaji proclaimed himself King of Xu; Li Mi received Yang Tong's edict to punish the rebels and was granted the title of Duke of Wei together with the offices of Grand Commandant and Minister of the Palace, and the Wagang army thereby gained legitimacy in the eyes of the lawful line, its strength and its territory swelling together. But the same war allowed Wang Shichong to strike back in Luoyang and crush Li Mi, while Dou Jiande in Hebei, styling himself a subject of the Sui who ought to punish the regicide, put Yu Wenhuaji to death, held funerals for Yang Guang and assumed the prestige of Empress Dowager Xiao; for a time the greater part of Shandong came over to him, and the Xia state became the strongest of the rival powers of the late Sui. The third consequence fell on institutions and on public feeling. In the second year of Zhenguan (628) Taizong of Tang judged the regicide by Pei Qiantong and the others to be unworthy, stripped them of rank and titles and exiled them; in the same year he pursued the other conspirators, Niu Fangyu, Xue Shiliang, Tang Fengyi and Gao Yuanli, and sent them all into exile in Lingnan; in the first month of the seventh year (633) he further decreed that the sons and grandsons of Yu Wenhuaji's party should not be admitted to office. That the killing of a sovereign was not to be pardoned, and that it carried the condemnation down to the descendants, was written into the record as a precedent that could not be reversed; in the reign of Empress Wu, when Yuwen Chengji petitioned in his father's name to be placed in a privileged office, the petition was refused to his face. On the local level, Jiangdu lost its standing as the travelling court, Yangdu fell from being the political heart of the empire to the seat of a single prefecture, and passed in turn to Shen Faxing and to the general of Du Fuwei, Fu Gongshi, as the south of the Yangtze entered a period of reintegration. The canal, the salt revenues and the rice of the south were bound once more into the central government's control in the Tang, and the fragmented jurisdictions of the late Sui in the lower Yangtze and the south-east were gradually closed up.
result: 這場亂事的結局，是一場乾淨利落但毫無建設性的毀滅。618年三月，隋煬帝楊廣在江都宮中被縊，隋朝失去了皇帝，也失去了它在江南的實際首都；宇文化及以丞相之名接管朝政不到一年，便因部將司馬德戡謀襲事發、兄弟相爭、眾心離散，於九月毒殺傀儡楊浩、自立許王，把一場宮廷政變升格為公開的僭越，反而給了竇建德與李密兩方同時進攻的理由。619年閏二月，竇建德會同王薄攻破聊城，宇文化及與二子被俘，押往襄國郡，在大陸縣被斬，首級送交突厥的義成公主；同時被公開處死的還有宇文智及、元武達、孟秉、楊士覽、許弘仁等骨幹，逃亡的裴虔通、封德彝、陳政、趙元楷等則先後降唐，宇文化及一系至此被徹底剷除。政治層面，隋朝的正統轉移到洛陽的楊侗手中，再於同年由楊侗遜位於唐，隋朝名號告終；地方層面，江都先後由沈法興與杜伏威、輔公祏掌握，輔公祏之亂平定之後，江南全境歸入唐的版圖，隋末以來分裂了十年的長江下游與東南終於歸於一統，運河沿線的漕運與州縣秩序得以重建。這場江都之亂留下的是一個沉痛的提醒：當一支禁軍同時握有首都、槍械與皇室的日常起居，而朝廷又把它放在一條會被切斷的運河的盡頭、讓它遠離本土太久時，它既可以殺死皇帝，也可以在一夜之間殺死篡位者。
resultEn: The outcome of this affair was a clean but wholly unconstructive destruction. In the third month of 618 Yang Guang was strangled in the palace at Jiangdu, and the Sui lost both its emperor and its effective capital in the south. Yu Wenhuaji took over the government in the name of chancellor, but in less than a year the plot of his officer Sima Dekan to strike him came to light, his brothers quarrelled, and his men scattered; in the ninth month he poisoned the puppet Yang Hao and proclaimed himself King of Xu, turning a palace coup into open usurpation and giving both Dou Jiande and Li Mi the reason to attack at the same time. In the intercalary second month of 619 Dou Jiande, with Wang Bo's help, broke Liaocheng; Yu Wenhuaji and two of his sons were taken alive, sent under guard to Xianguo prefecture and beheaded in the mainland county, and the head was delivered to the Princess Yicheng among the Turks. Executed in the same place at the same time were the backbone of the party, Yuwen Zhiji, Yuan Wuda, Meng Bing, Yang Shilan and Xu Hongren, while the fugitives Pei Qiantong, Feng Deyi, Chen Zheng and Zhao Yunkai surrendered to the Tang in turn, and the house of Yu Wenhuaji was thus wiped out completely. At the political level the legitimate line of the Sui passed to Yang Tong at Luoyang and was then abdicated by him to the Tang in the same year, and the name of the Sui came to an end. At the local level Jiangdu passed to Shen Faxing and then to Du Fuwei and Fu Gongshi, and once the rebellion of Fu Gongshi had been put down the whole of the south of the Yangtze entered the Tang empire; the lower Yangtze and the south-east, divided for ten years since the collapse of the Sui, were reunited at last, and the grain transport and the administrative order along the canal could be rebuilt. What this mutiny at Jiangdu left behind was a hard lesson: when a single guard corps holds at once the capital, the weapons and the daily life of the imperial household, and the court has placed it at the end of a canal that can be cut and has kept it too long away from its own country, it can kill an emperor, and it can kill the usurper within a single night.
